purpose: Synthetic reproductions of every class of disagreement between AgentCAD's kernel-only is_valid and the downstream validity gate (closed shells plus a closed orientable manifold mesh), plus guards against over-strictness. Generated by scripts/generate_validation_fixtures.py; verified against the official CADGenBench gate by the internal parity oracle on 2026-09-04.

closed_box.role: closed 20 mm cube; every layer passes

open_shell.role: cube with the +Z face removed: one open shell, no solid
open_shell.notes: Kernel-consistent and is_valid true, so a run would succeed and report a meaningless 6400 mm3 volume. The evaluator rule also rejects it on solid_count 0.

loose_face_compound.role: closed cube plus an unattached 5 mm face in one compound
loose_face_compound.notes: The loose face becomes an open shell. is_valid true and one solid, so the evaluator rule accepts it and the gate rejects it: a true gap.

nonmanifold_sewn_cubes.role: two edge-touching cubes sewn in non-manifold mode: one edge carried by four faces
nonmanifold_sewn_cubes.notes: Reproduces the CADGenBench fixture 250 rejection exactly: is_valid true, official 'mesh non-manifold: edge shared by 4 triangles'. max_faces_per_edge is 4.

nonmanifold_edge_prism.role: bow-tie profile extruded through the modeling API: one solid, zero net volume, four faces at the crossing edge
nonmanifold_edge_prism.notes: is_valid true. The gate rejects the four-triangle edge.

touching_edge_solids.role: two cubes fused along a touching edge, no shared topology
touching_edge_solids.notes: Passes the gate as two clean bodies. A validator that rejects this is over-strict.

touching_vertex_solids.role: two cubes fused at a touching corner, no shared topology
touching_vertex_solids.notes: Passes the gate. Guard against over-strictness.

overlapping_members.role: two overlapping cubes kept as compound members
overlapping_members.notes: Deliverable. Raw member volume 16000 double-counts the 4000 mm3 overlap; occupied volume is 12000 (public issue #126).

disjoint_solids.role: two closed cubes 30 mm apart in one compound
disjoint_solids.notes: Deliverable. The structure layer reports two solids so an expect_solids: 1 declaration can fail.

bowtie_prism_invalid.role: bow-tie face built from its self-intersecting wire, extruded; written as BREP because STEP export heals it
bowtie_prism_invalid.notes: BRepCheck_SelfIntersectingWire and BRepCheck_UnorientableShape. The official gate reads STEP only, so this case is pinned locally and not by the oracle.
